```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```


```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(seminr); library(knitr); library(kableExtra)
})
```

```{r data}
root <- Sys.getenv("WB_ANALYSIS_ROOT", unset = "latest_analysis")
df <- readRDS(file.path(root, "output/models/clean_data_with_diagnostics.rds"))
df <- df[!is.na(df$CE0), ]
SEED  <- 20260920
NBOOT <- 2000   # bootstrap resamples (as in 29_decision_alternatives.R)
NPERM <- 1000   # permutations for the MGA
```

```{r model-builders}
demo  <- c("Gender", "Age", "Education", "Income", "HHAsset")
items <- list(CP_WB = c("CP_WB1","CP_WB2","CP_WB3","CP_WB4"), CP_A = c("CP_A1","CP_A2","CP_A3"),
              CA = c("CA1","CA2","log_ca3"), PS = c("PS1","PS2"),
              TC = c("TC1_DamagedArea","log_econloss"),
              IC = c("IC1","IC2_1","IC2_2_imp","IC2_3_imp"), Tol = c("Tol1_5","Tol2_1","Tol4_5"))

mk_mm <- function(tol = items$Tol, ic = items$IC, drop = character(0)) {
  parts <- list(
    CP_WB = composite("CP_WB", items$CP_WB, weights = mode_B),
    CP_A  = composite("CP_A",  items$CP_A,  weights = mode_B),
    PE    = composite("PE",  single_item("PE")),
    CE0   = composite("CE0", single_item("CE0")),
    CA    = composite("CA", items$CA, weights = mode_B),
    PS    = composite("PS", items$PS, weights = mode_B),
    TC    = composite("TC", items$TC, weights = mode_B),
    IC    = if (length(ic) == 1) composite("IC", single_item(ic)) else composite("IC", ic, weights = mode_B),
    IB    = composite("IB", single_item("IB")),
    Gender    = composite("Gender",    single_item("gender")),
    Age       = composite("Age",       single_item("age")),
    Education = composite("Education", single_item("education")),
    Income    = composite("Income",    single_item("log_income")),
    HHAsset   = composite("HHAsset",   single_item("log_hh_asset")),
    InNP      = composite("InNP",      single_item("in_np")),
    Site      = composite("Site",      single_item("site_baoxing")),
    Tol   = composite("Tol", tol, weights = mode_A))
  do.call(constructs, unname(parts[setdiff(names(parts), drop)]))
}

# Dense layered structure of the primary model: every earlier layer points to every later one.
sm_for <- function(bg, pre, post, ce0 = TRUE) {
  mid <- if (ce0) "CE0" else character(0)
  p <- list(paths(from = bg, to = c(pre, mid, post, "Tol")))
  if (length(pre))  p <- c(p, list(paths(from = pre, to = c(mid, post, "Tol"))))
  if (ce0)          p <- c(p, list(paths(from = "CE0", to = c(post, "Tol"))))
  if (length(post)) p <- c(p, list(paths(from = post, to = "Tol")))
  do.call(relationships, p)
}

bg_all <- c("CP_WB", "CP_A", demo, "InNP", "Site")
pre1   <- c("TC", "PE")
post1  <- c("CA", "PS", "IC", "IB")

quiet <- function(expr) { out <- NULL; invisible(capture.output(out <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(expr)))); out }
fit   <- function(data, mm, sm) quiet(estimate_pls(data, mm, sm, missing = mean_replacement, maxIt = 500))
boot  <- function(m) quiet(summary(bootstrap_model(m, nboot = NBOOT, seed = SEED)))
pick  <- function(tbl, row) {
  if (!row %in% rownames(tbl)) return(c(est = NA, lo = NA, hi = NA, p = NA))
  r <- tbl[row, ]
  c(est = r[["Original Est."]], lo = r[["2.5% CI"]], hi = r[["97.5% CI"]], p = r[["Bootstrap P Val"]])
}
```

# Section 6 — Robustness

```{r six-specifications, cache=TRUE}
specs <- list(
  list("M0 (primary)", "None: primary model (Section 4.3)", mk_mm(),             bg_all,                pre1, post1),
  list("M_noSocio",    "Sociodemographic controls removed", mk_mm(drop = demo), setdiff(bg_all, demo), pre1, post1),
  list("M_noTangible", "Tangible cost removed",             mk_mm(drop = "TC"), bg_all,                "PE", post1),
  list("M_noPS",       "Policy dependency removed",         mk_mm(drop = "PS"), bg_all,                pre1, setdiff(post1, "PS")),
  list("M_IC1only",    "Intangible cost = general attitude (IC1) only", mk_mm(ic = "IC1"), bg_all, pre1, post1),
  list("M_TolFull",    "Tol3 restored (four-item tolerance)",
       mk_mm(tol = c("Tol1_5","Tol2_1","Tol3_1","Tol4_5")), bg_all, pre1, post1))

models <- list()
specA <- bind_rows(lapply(specs, function(s) {
  m  <- fit(df, s[[3]], sm_for(s[[4]], s[[5]], s[[6]])); models[[s[[1]]]] <<- m
  sb <- boot(m)
  tot <- pick(sb$bootstrapped_total_paths, "CE0  ->  Tol")   # total effect = RQ1 estimand
  dir <- pick(sb$bootstrapped_paths,       "CE0  ->  Tol")   # direct path
  data.frame(Specification = s[[1]], Change = s[[2]],
             Total = tot[["est"]], CI_low = tot[["lo"]], CI_high = tot[["hi"]], p = tot[["p"]],
             Direct = dir[["est"]], R2_Tol = summary(m)$paths["R^2", "Tol"])
}))
```

```{r table-specs}
specA %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))) %>%
  kable(caption = "CE0 -> tolerance under six specifications (total effect, 95% bootstrap CI)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("bordered", "condensed"))
```

## Item quality of the primary model

```{r item-quality}
s0 <- summary(models[["M0 (primary)"]])
data.frame(Item = items$Tol, Loading = round(s0$loadings[items$Tol, "Tol"], 3)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Tolerance outer loadings") %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
round(s0$reliability["Tol", ], 3)
vif_formative <- unlist(s0$validity$vif_items[c("CP_WB","CP_A","CA","PS","TC","IC")])
cat("Largest VIF among formative indicators:", round(max(vif_formative), 2), "\n")
```

The vibration-of-effects analysis is reported in Appendix A.6 (script `16_report_figures.R`).

# Section 7 — Multi-Group Analysis (exploratory)

```{r mga-functions}
align <- function(m, ref) {
  for (k in intersect(names(items), colnames(m$outer_weights))) {
    it <- rownames(m$outer_weights)[m$outer_weights[, k] != 0]
    if (sum(m$outer_weights[it, k] * ref$outer_weights[it, k]) < 0) {
      m$outer_weights[, k] <- -m$outer_weights[, k]
      m$path_coef[k, ] <- -m$path_coef[k, ]; m$path_coef[, k] <- -m$path_coef[, k]
    }
  }
  m
}
pooled_X <- function(cols) {
  X <- as.matrix(df[, cols])
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(X))) X[is.na(X[, j]), j] <- mean(X[, j], na.rm = TRUE)
  scale(X)
}
labels <- c(CP_WB = "Conflict experience, wild boar", CP_A = "Conflict experience, all species",
            PE = "Prevention effectiveness", TC = "Tangible cost", CA = "Compensation anticipation",
            PS = "Policy dependency", IC = "Intangible cost", IB = "Intangible benefit",
            Gender = "Gender", Age = "Age", Education = "Education", Income = "Income (log)",
            HHAsset = "Household assets (log)", InNP = "Park residence", Site = "Survey site (Baoxing)")

run_mga <- function(label, drop_demo) {
  bg <- if (drop_demo) setdiff(bg_all, demo) else bg_all
  mm <- mk_mm(drop = c("CE0", if (drop_demo) demo))      # CE0 is the grouping variable
  sm <- sm_for(bg, pre1, post1, ce0 = FALSE)
  ref <- fit(df, mm, sm)
  est <- function(d) align(fit(d, mm, sm), ref)
  g1 <- df[df$CE0 == 1, ]; g0 <- df[df$CE0 == 0, ]
  m1 <- est(g1); m0 <- est(g0)
  preds <- rownames(ref$path_coef)[ref$path_coef[, "Tol"] != 0]
  multi <- intersect(names(items), colnames(ref$outer_weights))
  X <- pooled_X(unlist(items[multi]))
  comp_c <- function(a, b) sapply(multi, function(k) {          # MICOM step 2
    it <- items[[k]]; cor(X[, it] %*% a$outer_weights[it, k], X[, it] %*% b$outer_weights[it, k]) })
  d_obs <- m1$path_coef[preds, "Tol"] - m0$path_coef[preds, "Tol"]; c_obs <- comp_c(m1, m0)
  set.seed(SEED)
  perm <- replicate(NPERM, {
    pl <- sample(df$CE0)
    a <- tryCatch(est(df[pl == 1, ]), error = function(e) NULL)
    b <- tryCatch(est(df[pl == 0, ]), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(a) || is.null(b)) rep(NA, length(preds) + length(multi))
    else c(a$path_coef[preds, "Tol"] - b$path_coef[preds, "Tol"], comp_c(a, b))
  })
  pd <- perm[seq_along(preds), , drop = FALSE]; pc <- perm[length(preds) + seq_along(multi), , drop = FALSE]
  p_perm <- sapply(seq_along(preds), function(i) {
    x <- na.omit(pd[i, ]); (1 + sum(abs(x) >= abs(d_obs[i]))) / (1 + length(x)) })
  paths_tab <- data.frame(Path = labels[preds],
                          Applicants = m1$path_coef[preds, "Tol"], NonApplicants = m0$path_coef[preds, "Tol"],
                          Diff = d_obs, p = p_perm, p_Holm = p.adjust(p_perm, "holm"), row.names = NULL)
  micom <- data.frame(Construct = multi, c_obs = c_obs,
                      q05 = apply(pc, 1, quantile, probs = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), row.names = NULL)
  micom$Invariant <- micom$c_obs >= micom$q05
  htmt_pairs <- function(m, grp) {
    h <- summary(m)$validity$htmt; h[upper.tri(h, diag = TRUE)] <- NA   # seminr fills the LOWER triangle
    w <- which(h > 0.85, arr.ind = TRUE); if (!nrow(w)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(Group = grp, A = rownames(h)[w[, 1]], B = colnames(h)[w[, 2]], HTMT = h[w]) }
  r2 <- data.frame(Group = c("Applicants", "Non-applicants"), n = c(nrow(g1), nrow(g0)),
                   R2 = c(summary(m1)$paths["R^2", "Tol"], summary(m0)$paths["R^2", "Tol"]),
                   AdjR2 = c(summary(m1)$paths["AdjR^2", "Tol"], summary(m0)$paths["AdjR^2", "Tol"]))
  list(paths = paths_tab[order(paths_tab$p), ], micom = micom,
       htmt = bind_rows(htmt_pairs(m1, "Applicants"), htmt_pairs(m0, "Non-applicants")), r2 = r2)
}
```

```{r mga-run, cache=TRUE}
mga1 <- run_mga("MGA 1", drop_demo = FALSE)   # tolerance equation of the primary model
mga2 <- run_mga("MGA 2", drop_demo = TRUE)    # the same, ONLY the demographics removed
```

```{r mga-tables, results='asis'}
show <- function(x, cap) print(kable(mutate(x, across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))), caption = cap) %>%
                                 kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("bordered", "condensed")))
for (r in list(list("MGA 1", mga1), list("MGA 2", mga2))) {
  show(r[[2]]$r2,    paste(r[[1]], "- R2 of tolerance by group"))
  show(r[[2]]$paths, paste(r[[1]], "- paths into tolerance, permutation p and Holm-corrected p"))
  show(r[[2]]$micom, paste(r[[1]], "- MICOM step 2 (compositional invariance)"))
  if (!is.null(r[[2]]$htmt) && nrow(r[[2]]$htmt)) show(r[[2]]$htmt, paste(r[[1]], "- HTMT > 0.85 within groups"))
}
```
